# GravityPort

> GravityPort is a free AI asset manager for ChatGPT, Gemini, Flow, Google AI Studio, Codex, Grok and Jimeng. Images and videos land in a library on your own computer as they're generated, with their prompts, reference images and sources.

GravityPort doesn't generate images. It collects them, automatically, from the tools you already use, and runs on Macs with Apple silicon and on Windows 10/11.

## What it does

- 100% Local: nothing goes to the cloud; every asset stays on your computer.
- Auto-Capture: images and videos are saved as they're generated. ChatGPT, Gemini, Flow, Google AI Studio and Jimeng through the browser extension; Codex and Grok read directly by the desktop app.
- Prompts & Context: the prompt, the instruction, reference images and the source are kept with every asset.
- Version Tree: images from one ChatGPT conversation line up round by round. Compare any two side by side and see which line changed it.
- Smart Stacks: every asset is grouped by source on arrival, and images from one conversation, Flow project or Codex task stack into a single card.
- Organizing: drop a card on a group to file it, or on another card to stack them. Images you already have can be dragged into the window.
- Built-in MCP: connect Claude or Codex to search and use your local library directly: assets, prompts, versions and generation history.
- Free Download: macOS (Apple silicon) and Windows 10/11.

## Privacy

- No account, no cloud, no sync, no uploads. Originals, Prompts and sources live in a folder you choose.
- The extension sends images and their source details only to GravityPort on your computer.
- The desktop app only goes online on its own to check for updates and send an anonymous activity signal at most once a day, neither with assets, Prompts, file names or paths.
